brief:
Palestine's real estate and construction exhibition opened at Ramallah Expo under the principal sponsorship and strategic partnership of Bank of Palestine, the Ma'an news agency reported. The 2026 Palestine Real Estate and Construction Expo brings together developers, contractors, and industry professionals for the multi-day event.

Bank of Palestine served as the financial backer for the exhibition, positioning the banking institution among the event's major supporters during the showcase of construction and real estate sector developments.
title: Palestine hosts real estate and construction expo in Ramallah
